Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Dash]]: the cover of P. D. Eastman's children's book ''Go, Dog. Go!'' (Random House, 1961).

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Go_Dog_Go.jpg File:Go Dog Go.jpg], English Wikipedia (258 by 323 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250816003847/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Go_Dog_Go.jpg Internet Archive], 16 August 2025.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (258 by 323 pixels) of the book's cover, the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
